text: The problem of negative existentials (e.g., 'there are no unicorns') is a challenge for truthmaker maximalism because:
choices: no positive entity's existence seems to necessitate the truth, prompting Armstrong to posit a higher-order 'totality' state of affairs as its truthmaker.
negative existentials are strictly meaningless and so are neither true nor false.
the correspondence theory has no way to define the truth predicate recursively.
they show that truth is merely disquotational and therefore needs no truthmaker at all.
explanation: Maximalism says every truth has a truthmaker, but 'there are no unicorns' has no obvious positive worldly correlate—any actual entity could coexist with a unicorn—so Armstrong introduces a higher-order totality fact (that the actual things are all the things) to do the work. Distractor 3 states the deflationist's response to the puzzle, not the reason it is a problem for the maximalist.
